description: Queue a transaction request on a multisig. Provide either raw `data`, or `abi` + `functionName` + `args` to encode it. With MYMULTISIG_PRIVATE_KEY (an owner) the agent signs it immediately; otherwise it is queued unsigned for the owners to sign in the app. Returns the request link to share.

abi.description: JSON ABI array as a string, or human-readable signature(s) like "function transfer(address,uint256)"

chainId.description: EVM chain id, e.g. 11155111 for Sepolia (see list_networks)

delegatecall.description: 0.5.0 Extended only, DANGEROUS: execute via DELEGATECALL

description.description: Human-readable purpose, shown to the other owners

sign.description: Set false to queue without the agent signature

txnGas.description: Gas forwarded to the inner call; estimated when omitted

txnNonce.description: Extended wallets: pin to an explicit nonce

validUntil.description: 0.5.0 wallets: unix-seconds expiry of the signatures

valueEther.description: Native value as a decimal in ether units, alternative to value

name: propose_transaction
title: Propose a transaction
